The image shows a green leaf with several dark, irregular spots. Some spots are small and roughly circular, while one is larger and more irregularly shaped. These spots appear dark brown to black. This pattern aligns with the description of Anthracnose, which mentions "small, black, and irregular on leaves, expanding into large dead areas." The other descriptions do not match as well. Die_Back involves leaves rolling and twigs dying back. Sooty_Mould is a superficial dark deposit, not distinct spots within the leaf tissue. Powdery_Mildew would appear as a white or grayish powder, which is not present. Therefore, Anthracnose is the most likely diagnosis.
